## Où j'en suis

- [en-cours] Draft PR kestrel-analytics/platform#418 open (last commit d2286a0): 12-col grid with drag/resize on react-grid-layout, layout persisted via `PUT /dashboards/:id/layout` with localStorage fallback, widget sizing via a ResizeObserver hook (`data-size`), everything behind the `dashboards_v2` flag; awaiting Priya's UX review.
- [prochaine-étape] Priya's UX review on the iPad, then enable `dashboards_v2` for the Zest workspace only (flags admin config, no code) before the Zest demo on Tuesday the 24th.
- [essai-raté] Container queries (`@container` / `container-type`): silently ignored on Zest's iOS 15 iPads since they need Safari 16+, so widgets never changed size — replaced by the ResizeObserver hook.
- [décision] Drop the container queries completely and use option 2, the `useWidgetSize()` hook — "i dont want two systems" (source: t09)
- [décision] Rename `DashboardTile` to `WidgetCard` everywhere and run lint; a deprecated re-export was kept so v1 `DashboardList` still compiles (source: t11)
- [décision] Flag on only for the Zest workspace, old dashboards stay available behind the flag until January, nothing removed now (source: t15)
- [décision] Open the PR as a draft; Priya will review the UX tomorrow (source: t17)
